senses.gloss: वि—ष्ठल n. (fr. वि + स्थल, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 96) a remote place, a spot situated apart or at a distance, W.
1. विष्ठा f. (for 2. 3. See p. 999, col. 1) = 3. विष्, feces, excrement (acc. with √ कृ or वि-√ धा, to void excr˚), Mn.; MBh. &c. (often w.r. विष्टा).
3. वि-ष्ठा॑ f. place, position, station, form, kind, RV.; AV.; TBr.; ŚrS.
विष्ठा—भू m. a worm living in ordure, BhP.
विष्ठा—भूदारक m. a tame or village hog, L. (cf. विड्-वराह).
विष्ठा—सात् ind. into excrement or ordure (with √ अस्, to be turned into excrement or ordure), HYog.
3. वि-ष्ठा—व्राजि॑न् mfn. remaining in one place, stationary, ŚBr.
scattered, spread, diffused, ib.; TBr.; AV.
standing, fixed, stationary (opp. to जगत्), RV.; AV.
standing or being on or in (loc. or comp.), MBh.; R. &c.
being present or near, R.; Hariv.
